mapper.select:
SELECT /* getAuthGroupList */ P.AUTH_CODE , P.AUTH_NAME , P.USEE_YSNO , P.USEE_YSNO_NAME , P.REGI_ADMN , P.REGI_ADMN_NAME , P.REGI_DATE , P.UPDT_ADMN , P.UPDT_ADMN_NAME , P.UPDT_DATE FROM ( SELECT R.AUTH_CODE , R.AUTH_NAME , R.USEE_YSNO , R.USEE_YSNO_NAME , R.REGI_ADMN , R.REGI_ADMN_NAME , R.REGI_DATE , R.UPDT_ADMN , R.UPDT_ADMN_NAME , R.UPDT_DATE , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY R.AUTH_CODE) AS ROW_NUMB FROM ( SELECT A.AUTH_CODE , A.AUTH_NAME , A.USEE_YSNO , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{commYsno}, A.USEE_YSNO, #{useeYsnoCode}, 'ko') AS USEE_YSNO_NAME , A.REGI_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(A.REGI_ADMN) AS REGI_ADMN_NAME , A.REGI_DATE , A.UPDT_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(A.UPDT_ADMN) AS UPDT_ADMN_NAME , A.UPDT_DATE FROM TM_AUTHXM A WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY A.AUTH_CODE ) R ) P WHERE P.ROW_NUMB BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow} ORDER BY P.ROW_NUMB
SELECT /* getAuthGroupListCount */ COUNT(1) FROM TM_AUTHXM A WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT /* getAuthGroup */ A.AUTH_CODE , A.AUTH_NAME , A.USEE_YSNO , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{commYsno}, A.USEE_YSNO, #{useeYsnoCode}, 'ko') AS USEE_YSNO_NAME , A.REGI_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(A.REGI_ADMN) AS REGI_ADMN_NAME , A.REGI_DATE , A.UPDT_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(A.UPDT_ADMN) AS UPDT_ADMN_NAME , A.UPDT_DATE FROM TM_AUTHXM A WHERE A.AUTH_CODE = #{authCode}
SELECT /* getAuthGroupCount */ COUNT(*) FROM TM_AUTHXM WHERE AUTH_CODE = #{authCode}

SELECT /* getAuthMenuList */ #{authCode} AS AUTH_CODE , M.MENU_NUMB , M.SUBX_NUMB , M.MENU_NAME , M.MENU_URLX , M.SORT_ORDR , COALESCE(A.READ_YSNO, #{no}) AS READ_YSNO , COALESCE(A.WRIT_YSNO, #{no}) AS WRIT_YSNO , COALESCE(A.DELT_YSNO, #{no}) AS DELT_YSNO FROM TM_ADMENU M LEFT JOIN TB_AUTHMN A ON A.AUTH_CODE = #{authCode} AND A.MENU_NUMB = M.MENU_NUMB AND A.SUBX_NUMB = M.SUBX_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_ADMENU P ON P.MENU_NUMB = M.MENU_NUMB AND P.SUBX_NUMB = #{topMenuSubxNumb} WHERE COALESCE(M.USEE_YSNO, #{yes}) = #{yes} ORDER BY COALESCE(P.SORT_ORDR, M.SORT_ORDR) , CAST(M.MENU_NUMB AS UNSIGNED) , CASE WHEN M.SUBX_NUMB = #{topMenuSubxNumb} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END , COALESCE(M.SORT_ORDR, 9999) , CAST(M.SUBX_NUMB AS UNSIGNED)
